claims.text: Controlled processing or synthesis routes can introduce ordered dislocations into MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials.
Introducing ordered dislocations will improve the mechanical performance of MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials.
Ordered dislocations will increase the strength of MnNiSi-based materials relative to as-synthesized or conventionally processed material.
Ordered dislocations will increase the ductility of MnNiSi-based materials relative to as-synthesized or conventionally processed material.
Ordered dislocations improve mechanical performance by relieving internal stresses.
Ordered dislocations improve mechanical performance by increasing strain tolerance.
The ordered-dislocation intervention can retain a large magnetocaloric effect.
Within suitable limits of dislocation density and ordering, the defect structure will not significantly degrade the magnetocaloric effect.
The proposed improvement should hold over magnetic fields and temperatures relevant to magnetic refrigeration.
